title: RepoPilot evaluation task
description: One committed, reproducible task under evals/tasks/. At least 30 must exist for an evaluation to be complete (FR-031, SC-011). Every success condition must be checkable without human judgement. Reference patches live under evals/tasks/_reference/, outside every fixture root, so no indexing or file-read path can reach them (FR-035).

$schema.description: Editor hint only. Declared so additionalProperties:false does not reject it.

id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. bugfix-null-guard-01. Used as seededTaskId when starting a run.

repositorySlug.description: Must match a registered fixture's slug.

category.description: Mix targeted by the README evaluation plan: 8 bug fixes, 6 input-validation changes, 6 API behavior changes, 5 refactors, 5 test tasks.

description.description: Given to the agent verbatim as the task. Must not name the files to change — that is the ground truth being measured.

relevantFiles.description: Ground truth for Recall@5. A task counts as retrieved when at least one of these appears in the top five retrieved results (FR-032, SC-005).

baselineTestCommand.description: Command name from the fixture's allow-list. Establishes the pre-change state; for a bug-fix task this is expected to fail before the change.

successTestCommand.description: Command name from the fixture's allow-list, run after the approved change is applied.

successCondition.description: Machine-checkable completion criterion. No option here admits human judgement.

expectedChangedFiles.description: Optional diagnostic signal only. Never used to decide success — that is the success condition's job — and never shown to the agent.

referencePatch.description: Optional path under evals/tasks/_reference/. Kept outside every fixture root by design; read only by humans reviewing the dataset, never by the agent (FR-035).

examples.description: Requests to the order lookup endpoint return a 500 when the customer has no shipping address on file. It should return the order with a null shipping address instead of failing.
